name: The Magical City of Dalaran
label: Quest
description: The Magical City of Dalaran: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I had intended to be the first of us to step foot onto Azeroth, but recent events with the cult have changed my plans. As a result, I will be remaining here in Valanaar for a time. Fret not though, we have several mages awaiting our people's arrival in Dalaran. I'd encourage you to explore Azeroth while we set our affairs in order here. We will call upon agents such as yourself when you are needed.
When you are ready, please proceed to the dock just outside this lodge and board the skycutter ship there.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, you've made it. Wonderful. It's going to take us some time to get ourselves established here, so you may want to take some time to explore the city. Be warned however, try not to venture too far from the safety of the city proper.
As idyllic as this new land appears, it can be extremely dangerous to wander outside of Dalaran without appropriate preparation and experience.

sources.title: Quest text one player sent in, not confirmed by a second yet
